human_summary: Strict sequential nonce guard with an externally supplied expected nonce under bv32 wraparound arithmetic.
assumptions: The caller provides expected_nonce as an input rather than deriving it inside Tau.
All arithmetic is unsigned bv32 arithmetic with wraparound semantics.
The contract reflects exact current behavior, including the wraparound edge when last_used_nonce = 0xFFFFFFFF.

intended_preconditions: The current v1 public contract treats o2 and o3 as independent standalone outputs.
Sequentiality alone is not claimed to imply freshness.

analysis_partitions.intent: Wraparound and equality edge cases where o1 and o3 may hold without o2.
Freshness is weaker than strict sequentiality.

outputs.name: o4
outputs.contract_expr: 1 if (i3 == ((i2 + 1) & 0xFFFFFFFF) and i1 > i2 and i1 == i3) else 0

theorems.statement: For all inputs, o4 is exactly the conjunction of expected_ok, nonce_fresh, and nonce_sequential.
There exists an explicit input where o3 = 1 but o2 = 0, disproving the stronger review claim.
Distinct nonce_replay_guard_v1 output-vector regions are pairwise disjoint over the explicit input domain.
The nonce_replay_guard_v1 behavior atlas covers the explicit input domain.
The contract semantics and the Tau binary agree on the bounded assurance domain for nonce_replay_guard_v1.

evidence_links.note: The assurance registry already carries the o3-does-not-imply-o2 counterexample posture.
